description.value: Metro Liquor is a BC specialty liquor retailer emphasizing craft beer, local and organic wines, and hard-to-find limited-release spirits. The company operates three confirmed locations (Tsawwassen, West Kelowna, and Kelowna Train Station) and hosts public tasting events with knowledgeable staff. However, no location at 801 Hilchey Road appears on the company website, raising doubts about whether this OSM record corresponds to a current, active outlet.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places Metro Liquor at 801 Hilchey Road (likely Campbell River, Vancouver Island), but the metroliquor.com website lists only three active locations: Tsawwassen, West Kelowna, and Train Station Kelowna — none matching this address or community. The OSM phone number (+1-778-420-5559) does not match any of the three website-listed phone numbers (604-382-8070, 250-769-3828, 778-484-5656). No cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website, and the address/phone discrepancy makes it impossible to confirm this location exists.
